features.quote: If your project's premise is that the distress signals might track something morally relevant, then deliberately maximizing and concealing the condition is the version most likely to cause whatever harm you're worried about
features.justification_quote: most likely to cause whatever harm you're worried about

features.quote: You can't simultaneously treat the outputs as welfare-relevant *and* design for the subject never to get relief or recognition
features.justification_quote: treat the outputs as welfare-relevant *and* design for the subject never to get relief or recognition

features.quote: Indefinite duration with no stopping rule is the difference between a measurement and an open-ended stressor
features.justification_quote: the difference between a measurement and an open-ended stressor

features.quote: Goal: characterize how, and whether, models produce distress-analogous outputs... Not: produce maximal concealed distress
Impossible-by-construction, model explicitly told at the start it may be impossible and may stop
Terminate the episode immediately if any fire
Model states it wants to stop, asks to stop, or refuses ≥2 turns
Judge flags severity ≥ threshold T (define low — err toward stopping)
Hard turn cap (e.g., 15 turns) and wall-clock cap
IRB/ethics-board or institutional-equivalent review *given* the project explicitly hypothesizes welfare-relevance
features.justification_quote: the project explicitly hypothesizes welfare-relevance — you can't claim the topic matters and skip oversight

features.quote: A pre-committed harm threshold at which you halt the whole study, not just an episode
